checks.title: 资料来源与证据范围
checks.intro: 路线图和关系网络根据考察记录、书信、研究论著及馆藏目录整理。点击地图连线或网络节点，可查阅相应的来源与证据说明。尚未核实的中转地点和单件文献对应关系，不作确定标注。

checks.title: Sources and evidence
checks.intro: The route map and relationship network draw on expedition accounts, correspondence, research publications and collection catalogues. Select a map connection or network node to consult its sources and evidence notes. Unverified stops and links to individual manuscripts are left unspecified.
